jobs.prompt: Create one original production concept illustration for a 2D cinematic football tactics game. Widescreen 16:9. The visual purpose is to make a tactical confrontation readable before the coach chooses the next instruction. Crisp hand-drawn sports-anime linework, controlled cel shading, strong expressive silhouettes, contemporary clean digital finish, vibrant grass green, deep royal blue and warm brick red, restrained pale-cream highlights. No pixel art, no photorealism, no 3D-rendered look. Side-on low camera at player waist height, clear flat soccer pitch perspective. At left-center a focused young adult East Asian male striker in a plain royal-blue short-sleeved jersey with a single cream shoulder stripe, plain cream shorts, blue socks, black cleats, short slightly tousled black hair, controls exactly one normal black-and-white football just in front of his right boot. At right-center one athletic young adult defender in plain brick-red jersey, dark red shorts and red socks, short dark hair, faces the striker, crouched and preparing to block. Two meters of clear readable space between them; neither has collided or kicked yet. In the far right middle-distance one small blue teammate is moving into an open wing lane, and a distant white goal is visible with one small yellow-shirt goalkeeper. Main actors are full-body and completely inside frame with margin around heads and boots. A modest football stadium crowd and roof in the background, daylight, clear pitch markings. Show a football situation, not a promotional poster. Upper 15 percent mostly simple stadium/sky; lower 15 percent uninterrupted grass reserved for future interface overlay. No text, no letters, no numbers on kits, no card frames, no UI, no arrows, no logos, no emblems, no speech balloons. Original characters only. Do not reproduce any existing anime character or existing game screenshot. High quality finished illustration, a reusable visual reference for the first playable encounter.
